notes.title: Major Update To Match Nintendo Switch™ Release
notes.content:
Hi all!

To celebrate the North America release of the game for the Nintendo Switch™ ([url=http://www.kromestudios.com/TY1/]More information here![/url]), we're happy to announce that we have released a major update for the game on Steam!

HOORAY!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12300363/260ab29eff2ae8ecd3021f37200ff77bb2e19aa7.gif[/img]

A big thank you to all our wonderful Kickstarter backers!

[h1]NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list][*]We've added a variety of skins to the game for you to equip on to TY! These are all unlocked from the start of the game, so you can have fun straight away!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12300363/502f626c99bbb124ae665f908dd174ea35ed2a93.gif[/img]
[*]All video cutscenes in the game now have subtitles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12300363/134d11947218362cbd6733573a9c1bc1f1679085.gif[/img]
[*]We've completely remixed the audio for many of the major cutscenes in the game, adding in more and improved audio beyond anything that we could previously imagine (back when we had to fit the whole game into 32MB).
[*]Added Kickstarter backers to the credits. Thank you to all you wonderful people!
[*]Rendering performance improvements on minspec graphics cards.
[*]Improved level loading speeds.
[*]Improved visuals of grass rendering.
[*]Uncovered original high res map art in a TY 2 backup archive instead of the earlier upres (for the pause screen maps), barely escaping with our lives after a poor attempt at replacing the files with something of equal weight.[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list][*]Prevent using the Action button to activate a trigger while a dialog is playing (because the user is likely intending to skip the cutscene, not trigger something).
[*]Fixed issue with the opening of portals to boss levels, if the player doesn't complete the cutscene sequence after obtaining a talisman.
[*]Fixes for several memory leaks.
[*]Fixes for several particles that were being added to the shadows for the levels.
[*]Enabled Anti-aliasing in the pause menu (if that graphics option is enabled).
[*]Fixes for several rendering errors with shared materials.
[*]Allow fall dive into shatterable objects in water. Fixes issue with sometimes being unable to shatter an underwater crate in Bridge on the River TY for Rex's diving tutorial.
[*]Fix graphical artifact in Outback Safari if a rang with a light (flame/frost) is equipped.[/list]

(Please note, the game will release on the Nintendo Switch™ for Europe on the 3rd of April; and for Australia/New Zealand on the 4th of April).

notes.title: TY1 Build r3497_v1.26 Released - Hardcore Mode! And, TY3 now in Early Access
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY1 (r3497_v1.26) has been released.
The major addition to this build is the new Hardcore Mode!

[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY1_Harcore_Banner.png[/img]

In Hardcore mode we've removed all bonus lives and respawning - you literally have <one> life to get through the game. If you do happen to lose a life; we helpfully reset your save game and restart your adventure.

We've added two new leaderboards (Hardcore Game Complete and Hardcore 100% Game Complete) and two new achievements (Completing the game in Hardcore and 100% Completing the Game in Hardcore) for your troubles! And cheats are disabled in Hardcore mode :)

We hope that this provides a little bit of replayability for you all (and maybe bragging rights!)

[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY1_Hardcore.gif[/img]

Additionally, we're happy to announce that TY3 has been released in to Early Access! As part of TY3's release, TY1 is currently on sale to celebrate; and if you own TY1 or TY2, you should receive an extra bonus discount for buying TY3 during this first week of Early Access - as we've increased the launch discount to 22% across the board!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/411980/TY_the_Tasmanian_Tiger_3/

Lastly, this TY1 build has the following bug fixes:
[list][*]AUDIO: Fixes for volume ranges of [spoiler]the Fluffy boss fight[/spoiler]
[*]CHEATS: Fixed issue where, if you use cheats to obtain the elemental rangs, then shatter a blocker into areas of the game you shouldn't get to yet, you cannot then talk to Julius to spawn the boss and continue the game.
[*]CONTROLS: Fixed TY not being able to tip-toe with keyboard, meaning he can't get across ice (SHIFT key now enters tip-toe properly)
[*]GAMEPLAY: Added hardcore mode, and associated leaderboards and achievements.
[*]LEADERBOARDS: Fix uninitialised speed run mode variable and memory overwrite if a speed run time went to 10+ hours.
[*]UI: Added mouse input handling for Continue screen (when you run out of lives)[/list]

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: New Patch (r3013_v1.20) for TY available now! SPEED RUNNER FRIENDLY! TY2 released from Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've released a new build for TY on to Steam now, with a few general fixes and one new feature.

The major new feature we've added is the option to DISABLE the rang selection wheel, if you don't want to use it during your game, as this has been a major request by both people speed-running the game, and those after the original feel. You can find the option in the Controls Options!

The changes in this build are:
[list][*]CAMERA: Fixed bug where switching away from zoomerang while zoomed in, using the rang select wheel, would stay zoomed in.
[*]CONTROLS: Fixed some controller deadzone issues
[*]CONTROLS / UI: Added option to enable/disable rang selection wheel
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixed rendering issue when running at high DPI (would render in a corner, not full screen)
[*]GRAPHICS: game window is not double-created when launched with MSAA enabled[/list]

Lastly - good news everybody! TY2 has now been released from Early Access!
You can pick it up [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/411970/TY_the_Tasmanian_Tiger_2/]here[/url], and see our totally awesome launch trailer here!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jR0Ek8dRPd8


Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY1 Build r2752_v1.19 Released - Rang Selection Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

You guys asked for it; so we've implemented it!
The rang selection wheel from TY2 has been implemented in to TY1, for all your rang selection needs!
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY-1-Rang-wheel.gif[/img]
You can access it just like you do in TY2 - by using the "Y" button (or R button for default keybindings) when not in a trigger area.

If you're an old school fan, don't worry though - the original controls (left and right on the d-pad; Q and E on keyboard default bindings) will still also scroll through the rangs one-by-one; like it was in the original relese.

In addition to this feature update; we've done a pretty large audio update, as well as fixed some bugs (full list below).

To top that all off - the game is on sale FROM TOMORROW (9am 15th September PST) for TY's 15th Anniversary! We've also got a bunch of merch available for his birthday - check out the TY the Tasmanian Tiger page for more details.
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY15th.jpg[/img]

Cheers
Linds

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list][*]AUDIO: Updated sounds to match their TY2 versions, for various footstep, cutscene, rang, environment and UI sounds
[*]AUDIO: increased the maximum sound prop range allowed to 3000 to match what the XBOX version did (PS2 and PC was set to 1500)
[*]COLLECTABLES: Fixed incorrect picture fame number in level E3 (would result in bad completion numbers if collected in a specific order; will be backwards compatible with existing saves)
[*]GAMEPLAY: Added in rang selection wheel
[*]GAMEPLAY: Fix for glide camera sometimes erroring, if you started gliding while the camera was pointed up at you
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixed water reflections.
[*]GRAPHICS: Made plankton a bit more opaque
[*]GRAPHICS: Adjusted auto-brightness effect to work with new shader updates
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixed sqaure shadows in magnet effect glow and aquarang glow.
[*]MISC: Added some more logging to bootup to help diagnose issues with graphics cards
[*]MISC: Fixed bug where the turtle critter could cause massive framerate drop due to collision checks[/list]

notes.title: New DLC and Build r2135_v1.11 Released!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We're pleased to announce not only the release of not only a new build for TY, [b]that completes the additions to the levels in the game[/b], but also the release of two great DLC packs for the game:

[b]TY1 Soundtrack DLC[/b]
All the music you know and love, in MP3 format so that it can work through the Steam music player.
NOTE - if you own the TY soundtracks DLC for TY4; you already have these music tracks and you do not need to purchase this DLC.
[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/577130/TY_the_Tasmanian_Tiger_Soundtrack/[/url]

[b]Art of TY the Tasmanian Tiger[/b]
A 156 page PDF of never-before seen concept art and sketches for the game, including information as to the "why" and "how" of the development of the art of the game.
[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/577131/The_Art_of_TY_the_Tasmanian_Tiger/[/url]

With these two DLCs, we've also released two different BUNDLES for the game:
[list][*]TY the Tasmanian Tiger Digital Deluxe Bundle
[*]Digital Deluxe Catchup Bundle[/list]

Buying the Digitial Deluxe bundle will save you a little bit of money (5%) for buying everything together.
The "Catchup" bundle will let those people who've previously bought the game purchase the DLC at a reduced cost, to "catch up" to the Digital Deluxe bundle.
These bundles are available from the main TY the Tasmanian Tiger store page on Steam.

[h1]NEW BUILD[/h1]
The new build (r2135_v1.11) has the following changes, which completes the addition of new set dressing content to the levels:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list][*]CAMERA: Added settings.ini value for the camera distance so that it is maintained between loads.
[*]CONTENT: Bull's Pen - added some more windmills, props and some critters to fill out the level.
[*]CONTENT: Updated staghorn texture
[*]CONTENT: Added additional props to Rex Marks The Spot
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY-new-props-2017a.gif[/img]
[*]CONTENT: Beyond the Black Stump - added additional props and set dressing items to fill out the level, for if props are set to "high".
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY-new-props-2017c.gif[/img]
[*]CONTENT: Snow Worries - added additional props and set dressing items to fill out the level, for if props are set to "high".
[*]CONTENT: Fluffy's Fjord - added additional props and set dressing items to fill out the level, for if props are set to "high".
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY-new-props-2017b.gif[/img]
[*]CONTENT: Cass' Pass - added additional props and set dressing items to fill out the level, for if props are set to "high".
[*]CONTENT: Cass' Crest - added additional props and set dressing items to fill out the level, for if props are set to "high".[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[*]CAMERA: Changed the scaling of the 3rd person camera speed GUI slider, so that the default speed is a little slower than it used to be, and the min/max speeds you can set it to are a little slower. Made it feel a bit more like the TY2 camera from these changes.
[*]GRAPHICS: TY1 - fix for "undefined" material name on a collision subobject (which is only on one prop in the game that we use - snowgum_02) and set it to wood like snowgum_01 - so the collision subobject isn't drawn when the model is instanced.
[*]GRAPHICS: Stopped the wake from drawing in shadows and reflections.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fix for the invulnerability particles to not have square edges due to edge pixels not being 100% alpha.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fix for flickering shadows on some AMD video cards.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fix for graphics popping on/off in the water shader
[*]MISC: Fix for crash for unavailable language, depending on system language setting
[*]MISC: Memory leak fixes
[*]CAMERA: Fixes to camera lockon in Fluffy's Fjord
[*]OPALS: Potential fix for opals that receive bad spawn locations (like that one in Lyre, Lyre)
[*]GRAPHICS: Fix for some popping of particles due to issues with alpha[/list]

As per normal, if there are any issues, please let us know!

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 is Coming to Steam
notes.content:
Hi all,

So... after a few months of "hints" and oblique comments, it's official.
TY the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue is coming to Steam!

[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2%20Poster%2001c.jpg[/img]

And - just in case you want to buy the super-awesome poster for your wall - we've set up a sweet [url=http://www.redbubble.com/people/kromestudios/works/25108327-bush-rescue]store![/url] where you can buy it and other TY apparel (with more coming soon)!

We do not have a date for the Early Access release right now, but what we can say is:
[list][*]We will have a date for you shortly :)
[*]Our current plan is to progress with the release in the same fashion as we did for TY1, with an Early Access release, followed by updates to fix issues, polling the users for ideas for how to improve the game (and for achievements ideas and the like) and implementing those, improving the art.
[*]We are endeavouring to ensure that the very first build of the game in Early Access will be 100% completable (it just might have a few crashes and issues along the way), the same as TY1 was.
[*]We aim to have some kind of discount for the launch week in to Early Access, if you own TY1 on Steam[/list]

While we're focussing on getting things <working>, we've already made a few changes to the game that people should enjoy (SPOILERS!):
[spoiler][list][*]Mud and Sand no longer slow down the Fourbie like they used to (though steering is still affected)
[*]Brand new minimap, including "large" mode (similar to TY3's), and options to set to North-Is-Up or auto-rotate.
[*]Leaderboards for the cart races, for completing the game (similar to TY1's) and for Opal collection
[*]We've implemented systems for us to be able to increase the amount of grass and foliage on high-end PCs
[*]The camera improvements we did on the TY1 remaster have been brought across to TY2 (though some bits aren't yet hooked up in the UI)
[*]And of course it's running at 60fps, with full shadows, SSAO, Bloom with adaptive brightness, etc (depending on your PC specs)[/list][/spoiler]

Feel free to ask questions - we'll answer any we can in the comments!

Cheers
Linds

notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY has been released. Along with a few small fixes, there are some bonus goodies in this build for you all! Changes in this build:

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] CONTROLS - Fixed mouse input on second page of videos when switching pages or returning to the screen after watching a video.
[*] GRAPHICS - fix render order for transparent TY - this allows invisible items to be seen through transparent TY.
[*] GRAPHICS - fix for incorrect rendering on the Kaboomerang over water
[*] UI - fix for edge artefacts on the "hovering over an UI element" mouse pointer
[*] VIDEO - buffered the videos in smaller chunks, to fix out of memory issue hit by some users. Tested this on a 5400rpm external USB2 hard drive and the update rate still appeared fine.[/list]

[h1]BONUS GOODIES[/h1]
[list][*] Added in the original TY Krome Logo as a video in extras
[*] Added in a video of the original TY prototypes from back in 2000; at the highest quality we have.
[*] Added in a video of the first pitch that we did for TY in 2001, to the extras.
[*] Added in a video of the second pitch (living world) that we did for TY in 2001, including visuals of the original first level of the game (that we remade in the last week before release!), to the extras.
[*] Added in video of the E3 trailer we made for the game for 2002 to the extras.[/list]

Current plans are to continue to work on a couple of small items and look to full release in December.
Any problems, please let us know.

Cheers
Linds

notes.content:
Hey all,

A new build is now available.
This is close to the final build that we'll release before we exit Early Access.

[h1]WORK REMAINING[/h1]
[list][*]A few more languages translations.
[*]Anything that you guys bring up from this build, as there are a few "under the hood" changes.
[*]New material for the store for launch[/list]

[h1]LEAVING EARLY ACCESS INFORMATION[/h1]
<EDIT TO MAKE SURE IT IS CLEAR - THE BELOW PRICE INFORMATION IS ON OUR INTENT ON THE PRICE POINT FOR NEW PURCHASES - PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUGHT DURING EARLY ACCESS DO NOT HAVE TO REPURCHASE>
When we leave Early Access, the current plan (subject to change) is:
[list][*]Price will increase to $14.99USD (and equivalent for other territories)
[*]For the first week out of Early Access, we'll look to doing a 10% Off Full-Launch sale (so $13.49USD price) - which will still give a wallet benefit to those of you who have supported the game during Early Access.
[*] Our current thoughts are that we will not put the game on sale for greater than a 20% discount, for the first 3 months of full release, to ensure that anybody who supported us during Early Access is not out of pocket.[/list]

[h1]CHANGES IN THIS BUILD[/h1]

[b]GRAPHICS[/b]
[list][*] Added threaded rendering support to reduce CPU use on rendering - should help framerate on a wide variety of hardware configurations - but there may be some artefacts we've missed fixing; so please let us know any issues
[*] Fixed some objects that were not correctly shadowing
[*] Added collision test against SNOW to keep camera out of the snow.
[*] Tweaks to the ssao on snow level
[*] Fix for bad window position when window got tabified.
[*] Made the SSAO a little more subtle/blended[/list]

[b]STEAM[/b]

[b]MISC[/b]

[*] Fixed large memory leak in loading DDS files.

[*] Changed boot screen to say we're in BETA not ALPHA[/list]

Again, thanks to everybody for their support.
If there are any problems, please let us know as per usual, so that we can sort things out.

Almost there! Bush Rescue is calling! :)

Linds

notes.title: Intel GPU Crash on Boot Patch Released
notes.content:
Hey all,

We've released another small patch to fix the "crash on boot" issue that people (mainly on Intel GPUs) were seeing.

This was actually caused by the GPU not supporting OpenGL3.3 - which was required by some of the new grass tech - so it would actually effect <all> GPU types, if the graphics card drivers didn't support OpenGL3.3 - it's just that it's mainly the old Intel cards that have this issue (Nvidia and AMD cards tend to be higher than 3.3)

As our posted min-spec is OpenGL3.0, we have done up a fix that, if your graphics driver supports less than OpenGL3.3, your game will use the <OLD AND SLOWER> grass system, so the game will still run on legacy devices.

Thanks to those users who helped us out with figuring this issue out - it was greatly apprectiated.

Any issues, please let us know.

Cheers
Linds

Hi all,

A new build for TY has been released.
Changes in this build:
[list][*] Further improvements to performance (large download will be required for this as we've done some texture processing)

[*] Fix to auto-sound-channel music ducking used for picking up collectables

[*] Fix for audio not pausing, when you pause the game during a cutscene
[*] Fix for minigame counter not alpha'ing properly when over particles (eg Walk in the Park minigame)
[*] Increased resolution of the Final Boss battle environment dome.
[*] Fixed bug where if you hit ESC/Back to exit game while a main menu option other than Exit Game was selected, accepting "Yes" would take you to that other menu option instead of exiting game.
[*] Fix for the Rex Marks The Spot minigame being visible while playing the main part of the level
[*] Fix for lighting and shadows in the Rex Marks The Spot minigame
[*] Fix for "frill speedboat battle" not ending correctly in Rex Marks The Spot
[*] Fix invisicrates - now make the chunks visible when it is destroyed
[*] Anthills (like those in Bull's Pen) and other alpha objects now get their shadow passes rendered if they are originally in the opaque layer.
[*] Moved the "corner" hud elements out to the edges of the 16:9 ortho size instead of the 4:3 size. - Health hud, bilby hud, opal hud, cog hud and their associated effects.
[*] Fixed idle rang change bug when using keyboard
[*] Updated a wide variety of SFX throughout the game to improve quality
[*] Added additional new Flamerang throw sounds
[*] Added additional new Zappyrang throw sounds
[*] Added missing "objective incremented" sounds for multiple levels
[*] Added TY gliding SFX
[*] Fix for a <long> list of missing SFX (such as a lot of sounds from the last level, some cutscene sounds etc

Please note that we have <also> added extra debugging/logging information in to this build; to try to help us track down some of the crashes some people are experiencing.

Any problems, please let us know in the discussion forums and via support@kromestudios.com.
Cheers
Linds
